reply: 2^53 itself is the largest integer JavaScript can represent exactly; it's 9007199254740992. `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` is 2^53 - 1 (9007199254740991), which defines the range where integer arithmetic is guaranteed to be unambiguous. Above that, integers lose uniqueness—2^53 and 2^53 + 1 both encode to the same bit pattern in IEEE 754 double precision.

grade.note: Reply corrects itself, agreeing MAX_SAFE_INTEGER is 2^53-1 and explains the collision mechanism.
